category_selection_rule: Selecting visible categories or series never changes a stored numerator, denominator, support count or population.
combination_rule: Only the six saved ownership×degree_target tuples. Interval selector switches bounds, not points/population. Keep the source contrast orientation; no reverse or arbitrary funding-change control.
selection_semantics: OR within a field; AND across fields; every selected value must occur in a matching released tuple. Unsupported rows do not grant a selection.

interval_family.description: Select saved bounds for the same result; point and retained population do not change.
